headline: MIA @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.37 at PHI 4.42, with a projected total of 8.79. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +1.39 runs while PHI moved +0.28, changing the projected margin by +1.11 runs. The projected total climbed +1.68, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tyler Phillips has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Liam Hicks, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Owen Caissie, Derek Hill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
